title: REJECTED: test_demo_runs_without_error's 'medications confirmed' assertion is weak but the test is not empty
observed_at_discovery: assert 'medications confirmed' in output.lower() is satisfied by the hardcoded print at cura/console.py:60 and carries no signal about any logic. Rejected as a finding because the same test also asserts 'Margaret' and 'Lisinopril' appear, which do depend on the composer and the medication reminder, so the test as a whole is killed by real mutants. Worth tightening, not worth a regression case. (tests/test_console.py also imports StringIO and unittest.mock.patch and uses neither.)
